items.title: Tokyo Before Tokyo

choices.response: Nara is an older capital. Try the city you are in.
Fuji is a mountain. Look at the city name.
Kamakura was a different seat of power.

items.reveal: Edo became Tokyo when the emperor moved here.

moreInfo.title: Edo
moreInfo.text: Edo was the Tokugawa shogun’s city. In 1868 it was renamed Tokyo, eastern capital.

items.notes: Confirm the 1868 rename wording before live.

items.title: The 60-Second Silence
items.task: Stop somewhere busy. Stay silent for one minute. How many different sounds can you name?
items.reveal: A loud city is also a listening city.

items.title: Konbini Roulette
items.task: Find one food or drink nobody has tried. Buy it. Everyone tastes it.
items.notes: Intended replacement for live sample tokyo-konbini. Sample stays live.

items.title: Machine Hunter
items.task: Find the strangest vending machine or vending-machine product you see.
items.notes: Intended replacement for live sample tokyo-vending. Sample stays live.

items.title: Millions of Quiet People
items.task: On a busy train, notice what people do so they do not disturb each other.
items.reveal: Tokyo trains work because people share the quiet, not only because of the rails.
